name: How long does a metal roofing estimate take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a metal roofing estimate take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a metal roofing estimate typically varies but usually takes about 30 minutes to an hour for an on-site inspection. This allows our team to thoroughly assess the roof's current condition, measure accurately, and discuss material options with you. Following the inspection, you can expect to receive a detailed quote within a few business days, depending on the complexity of the project. We prioritize timely delivery to help you make informed decisions regarding your roofing project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A metal roofing estimate typically takes 30 minutes to an hour for on-site inspection. A detailed quote follows within a few business days, based on project complexity.
